product.title: NOCO Boost GB40 1000A UltraSafe Lithium Jump Starter
product.problem: A dead 12-volt car battery can leave a driver stranded with no dependable way to start the engine.
product.target_audience_us: US drivers who commute, road-trip, or park outdoors and want a compact backup for a dead battery.

benefits.claim: Delivers 1000 amps of peak lithium power and up to 20 starts per charge for engines up to 6.0 liters gas and 3.0 liters diesel.
benefits.evidence: Amazon listing: START DEAD BATTERIES - 1000 amps peak lithium power, up to 20 starts per charge, engines up to 6.0L gas and 3.0L diesel.

benefits.claim: Uses spark-proof connections and reverse polarity protection to reduce connection mistakes.
benefits.evidence: Amazon listing: ULTRASAFE TECHNOLOGY - patented spark-proof and reverse polarity protection for any 12-volt vehicle.

benefits.claim: Includes an integrated power bank and a 100-lumen LED with several light modes.
benefits.evidence: Amazon listing: PORTABLE POWER BANK and INTEGRATED LED FLASHLIGHT with 100 lumens and 7 light modes.

objections.objection: Will it take up much space in the car?
objections.response: Check the dimensions and weight listed on the Amazon page before deciding where to store it.

objections.objection: Is it safe for someone who has never used jumper cables?
objections.response: The listing describes spark-proof connections and reverse polarity protection; read the manufacturer guidance supplied with the unit.

objections.objection: Will it handle a larger engine?
objections.response: The listing rates it for gasoline engines up to 6.0 liters and diesel engines up to 3.0 liters; confirm your engine size first.

objections.objection: Can it help when a phone battery dies too?
objections.response: The listing describes an integrated power bank for phones and tablets.

product.title: No-Drill Under-Desk Cable Management Tray
product.problem: Loose cables under a desk create clutter and make it harder to reach outlets or clean the floor.
product.target_audience_us: US office workers and remote employees who want a tidier under-desk setup.

benefits.claim: Mounts under the desk without drilling.
benefits.evidence: User-provided product description: No-Drill Under-Desk Cable Management Tray.
User-provided product description: Clamp-On Steel Wire Organizer for Office Desk.

benefits.claim: Uses a steel wire organizer for cables beneath an office desk.
benefits.evidence: User-provided product description: Steel Wire Organizer for Office Desk.

objections.objection: Will it fit my desk thickness?
objections.response: Check the clamp range listed on the Amazon page before ordering.

objections.objection: Will it hold my power strip and adapters?
objections.response: Review the dimensions and load guidance on the Amazon listing.

objections.objection: Do I need tools to install it?
objections.response: The product description specifies no-drill installation; confirm the included hardware on the listing.

objections.objection: Will it match my desk finish?
objections.response: Check the color options shown on Amazon.
